Health and Disability Commissioner — Te Toihau Hauora, Hauātanga

The Health and Disability Commissioner promotes the rights of all people in New Zealand who use health and disability services.

Your Rights

Your Rights in different languages

We have information about your rights in 25 languages, including audio resources.

Your rights in different languages

Looking for our provider education modules?

Our online learning modules are designed to support your learning in a way that’s relevant for all practitioners and can be done anywhere.

Online learning

Need help to make a complaint?

If you want to know more about your rights when using health or disability services, get questions answered, or make a complaint, the Advocacy Service can help.

Advocacy

Respecting Your Rights video

We recently launched the Your Rights animated video to encourage everyone to know their rights so they can ask questions, get support and make sure their voices are heard.
